podcast.body: A hit song by Richie Valens that was rising up the charts at the time of his death. "Vitchy Valens, whose hit Donner, was rising up the charts in a way that it doesn't matter anymore, was notably failing to do."

podcast.body: This song was named after a girl with whom Valens had a relationship or crush and was completed with assistance from Doug Machia. Initially a demo recorded in Valens' basement, it was later used as the B-side for "La Bamba," with session musicians overdubbing their parts onto the original track. Despite being the B-side, "Donna" became the more successful commercial hit, reaching number two on the charts. "Donna became the bigger hit."

srcs.source: A History of Rock Music in 500 Songs

podcast.body: This song was reportedly about Richie Valens's girlfriend, whose parents did not want him to date her. "Yes, O'Donnell was about her."
